item.title: Pilar Sanders on Deion Sanders: Marriage, divorce and custody battle insights
item.summary: In 1999, Pilar and Deion Sanders exchanged vows and became parents to three children. Their journey was captured in a reality show until Deion sought divorce in 2011. This triggered a fierce custody battle enveloped in legal turmoil and, at one point, led to Pilar serving time in jail. The divorce, finalized in 2013, enforced child support. Their highly scrutinized personal conflicts remain a defining chapter of their story.
